question: Are type/relation-specific private rank-one factors or topology-aware factor seeding a new graph-ensemble mechanism?

evidence_answer.generic_graph_rank_one_ensemble: Yes, established by saved Kim2023 graph-layer BatchEnsemble evidence.
evidence_answer.heterogeneous_graph_ensembles: Yes, HGEN2025 and CHoE2026 already cover meta-path experts, structural routing and diversification.
evidence_answer.topology_aware_expert_initialization: Yes, saved GraphMoRE2025 varying curvature and PreGS2026 supervised graph head transfer. Existing R15 already proposes graph-band residual VJP factor seeding.
evidence_answer.exact_type_relation_rank_one_shared_back: Not established as an exact duplicate by the two new scoped primaries plus saved conclusions. This is a coverage limit, not a novelty result.

analytical_findings.statement: For each relation r and member m, D_(s_mr) W_r D_(r_mr) h equals h_prime=h+(r_mr-1)*h, y=W_r h_prime, y+(s_mr-1)*y. Type indexing does not change the identity. Apply at each exact factor site while preserving nonlinear operations, biases, normalization, state paths and shared/private contracts.
analytical_findings.consequence: The factors give a compact parameterization, not a new type-aware function class versus equally placed diagonal residual paths.

analytical_findings.statement: Type-specific vectors increase stored private parameters with number of eligible type/relation maps. Separate nonlinear member states generally keep M complete graph trajectories, temporal rotations, relation aggregation and dense transforms. Static graph schema and cutoff-valid sampling can be reused when inputs/sampling contracts coincide; member-dependent attention and nonlinear features cannot be reused merely because W is shared.
analytical_findings.consequence: Real storage utility is plausible; runtime savings require a measured end-to-end workload and competent shared-state heads/packed untied controls.

analytical_findings.statement: Replacing random private-factor initialization with typed/topological initialization falls inside the existing R15 graph-route seeding question unless an additional operation beyond graph residual directions, typed partitions, warm transfer or structural routing is defined.
analytical_findings.consequence: Do not reopen a parallel new-method lane for an index change.

conjectures: Type/relation-specific diagonal factors may help under represented semantic diversity when global factors share inappropriate channel adjustments; this is an empirical adaptation hypothesis.
Rare-relation specialization may harm through extra degrees of freedom; ensemble disagreement may track relation sparsity without improving calibrated decisions.
No claim follows that boundary-only factors can identify relation-specific uncertainty after a shared representation has erased that information.

minimal_future_admission_if_independent_.competent_recent_reference: THGP2026 HeteroGNN+TimeMix+TimeRoPE with Temp-Sub->Rel-Hist; THGFM with Temp-Sub->Rel-Future is the recent stronger Transformer family reference. A faithful exact source/runtime remains to be pinned before reproduction.

minimal_distinct_controls: Same native single backbone; identical temporal/type preprocessing
Shared backbone with private output heads and one common graph-state computation
Four-member global-factor graph BatchEnsemble versus typed-factor version with explicitly matched eligible map sites
Equally located diagonal residual-path implementation; treat exact equivalence as an audit rather than train a duplicate model
Competent untied compact ensemble plus a same-placement/rank-budget low-rank adapter ensemble, each with allowed packing/chunking
minimal_future_admission_if_independent_.attribution_contract: Hold pooling/member loss/head freedom, labels/splits, feature preparation, optimization and selection budget fixed when testing the type index. Pool class probabilities; any logit-pooling alternative is predeclared separately. Add shuffled-type or permuted-within-compatible-signature control only if topology/type-aware initialization is the independent named mechanism.
minimal_future_admission_if_independent_.decision_and_compute_requirements: Predeclare held-out predictive NLL and a fixed abstention-budget risk/selective-coverage decision metric; report discrimination too. Charge full prep/pretraining/all-members training and inference, dense/edge work, optimizer storage, peak memory and serving batch size. No native paper speed claim is transferred.
minimal_future_admission_if_independent_.stop_rule: Current lane stops before code or training because no independent method delta survives. If separately reopened for adaptation utility, stop promotion when gains vanish under same-site/global-factor/head controls or when only storage savings appear without a real storage constraint; also stop for infeasible faithful baseline/runtime or split custody.

novelty_limit: Absence of an exact retrieved duplicate is not a novelty proof; bounded metadata search and two primary reads do not exhaust heterogeneous ensembles/adapters.
